canonicalisation_check.verdict: Exact-match novelty is not a canonicalisation or stereochemistry artifact when this value matches the raw string comparison.

component_novelty.reconciliation_note: Distinct-component novelty exceeds product novelty because novel components are each used rarely while registry components are used constantly. A product can only enter the corpus if all three of its components are registry members and that exact triple was enumerated.

corpus_fold_structure.novelty_denominator: Novelty is defined against the train fold. Measuring against all folds counts calibration and heldout products as training data, which understates novelty.
corpus_fold_structure.why_folds_exist: The corpus is fold-split at the component-family level, not at the product level. Random product-level splitting of a combinatorial enumeration leaks badly, because a held-out product shares two of three components with training products. Family-level folds make the held-out set genuinely held out, and supply the held-out likelihood used for generator checkpoint selection.

distance_novelty_vs_train_fold.fingerprint_limitation: Binary folded Morgan fingerprints encode presence of local environments, not their counts, so alkyl homologs of different chain length can score 1.0. Chain length is a real potency determinant for ionizable lipids, so a perfect score here is a metric artifact rather than chemical equivalence.

murcko_scaffold_novelty.interpretation: Product scaffold novelty is close to uninformative for this chemistry. A lipid's Murcko scaffold is essentially its head ring, so the whole reference set collapses to a small number of scaffolds.

nonclaims: Novelty is not evidence of activity.
Exact-match novelty saturates near 1.0 for competent distribution learners and is a memorisation alarm, not a measure of how far the model reached.
Absence from a corpus we enumerated ourselves is weak in both directions: present may only mean the enumeration was thorough, absent may only mean it had a filter.
Scaffold novelty is close to uninformative for lipids.
purpose: Measure novelty of generated designs against every reference set that matters. Selects nothing.
